## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: An interrupt card is visible in the Supervisor thread within one coordinator...

The system SHALL ensure that an interrupt card is visible in the Supervisor thread within one coordinator poll interval of being opened.

#### Scenario: An interrupt card is visible in the Supervisor thread within one coordinator...

WHEN `deliver-interrupt-cards-to-the-supervisor-thread-and-pull-re` is implemented
THEN An interrupt card is visible in the Supervisor thread within one coordinator poll interval of being opened.

### Requirement: An answer given as an option token (2, 1a) or as free text in the Supervisor...

The system SHALL ensure that an answer given as an option token (2, 1a) or as free text in the Supervisor thread is recorded against the right card, and the worker that raised it resumes using that answer.

#### Scenario: An answer given as an option token (2, 1a) or as free text in the Supervisor...

WHEN `deliver-interrupt-cards-to-the-supervisor-thread-and-pull-re` is implemented
THEN An answer given as an option token (2, 1a) or as free text in the Supervisor thread is recorded against the right card, and the worker that raised it resumes using that answer.

### Requirement: A PR-scoped card appears as exactly one PR comment ending with the...

The system SHALL ensure that a PR-scoped card appears as exactly one PR comment ending with the attribution footer and is not re-posted on retry.

#### Scenario: A PR-scoped card appears as exactly one PR comment ending with the...

WHEN `deliver-interrupt-cards-to-the-supervisor-thread-and-pull-re` is implemented
THEN A PR-scoped card appears as exactly one PR comment ending with the attribution footer and is not re-posted on retry.

### Requirement: Opening the Supervisor thread lists every open card across all projects,...

The system SHALL ensure that opening the Supervisor thread lists every open card across all projects, oldest deadline first, without the operator naming a project.

#### Scenario: Opening the Supervisor thread lists every open card across all projects,...

WHEN `deliver-interrupt-cards-to-the-supervisor-thread-and-pull-re` is implemented
THEN Opening the Supervisor thread lists every open card across all projects, oldest deadline first, without the operator naming a project.

### Requirement: The Supervisor session's configuration grants no write access to...

The system SHALL ensure that the Supervisor session's configuration grants no write access to implementation source, and a delivery-channel fallback is named in the digest.

#### Scenario: The Supervisor session's configuration grants no write access to...

WHEN `deliver-interrupt-cards-to-the-supervisor-thread-and-pull-re` is implemented
THEN The Supervisor session's configuration grants no write access to implementation source, and a delivery-channel fallback is named in the digest.
